title: Exact-degree Fourier estimator program
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define a random-example learning program that draws a matrix of labeled examples, with one row for each set of coordinates of size at most $k$ and the prescribed number of samples in each row. It returns the exact-degree Fourier estimator output from this matrix and charges local work equal to the number of such coordinate sets times the sample count per coefficient times $n+1$.
